scope: Cloud recovery qualification for readiness milestone 2 (journal_idempotency, crash_recovery). GitHub-hosted Linux, Windows Server and macOS runners plus disposable PostgreSQL 16; scripted model. Not consumer hardware (milestone 9) and not real-model accuracy (milestone 5).

cases.case: Companion killed mid-write and restarted: reported unknown/interrupted, never re-run
Lost acknowledgement: the exact saved receipt is resent, the effect never re-executed
A restarted companion keeps durable intent identity; an interrupted read is recovered
An unknown write fences resumption; no new action is queued or provider called
The person resolves an unknown effect once (owner only, waiting task); the step is never redelivered; the planner sees the answer
A held claim whose permission is revoked is fenced; a late receipt is kept without reviving the action
Claim/STOP and a concurrent receipt never deadlock (task-before-action lock order)
STOP while a step runs: in-flight work cancelled and its effect accounted for
An in-place repair never silently replaces a version saved meanwhile

limits: The person, not an automatic probe, decides whether an unobserved effect happened.
Consumer Windows 10/11 and macOS hardware remain untested (milestone 9).
